textbookText: Unit 2 : Classification of living beings Section 'A'
Multiple choice questions.
Circle the correct alternative of the following questions
1. Angiosperms are classified into two different classes based on which of the following characteristics?
i) on the basis of number of cotyledons present in their seeds
ii) on the basis of venation on leaves
iii) on the basis of root system
iv) on the basis of structure of flower
Ans:- i) on the basis of number of cotyledons present in their seeds
2. Which scientist is the father of five kingdom classification system?
i) Carolous Linneus ii) James Watt
iii) Gregor Mendel
iv) Robert Harding Whittaker
Ans:- (iv) Robert Harding Whittaker
3. which phylum does the animal with characteristics of segmented body, elongated and round belongs to?
i) Platyhelminthes ii) Annelida
iii) Arthropoda
iv) Nematoda
Ans:- ii) Annelida
4. Which phylum does the animal with characteristics like multicellular, pores all over the body and sessile belongs to?
i) Mollusca
ii) Coelenterata
iii) Porifera
iv) Protozoa
Ans:- iii) Porifera
5. Why is Cycas kept in gymnosperm?
i) Bears flowers, produces seed.
iii) Bears cones instead of flowers, seeds are naked without fruit
ii) Bears flowers, leaves are needle-like.
iv) Bears cones instead of flowers, seeds are enclosed in fruit
Ans:- Bears cones instead of flowers, seeds are enclosed in fruit
6. Two animals are shown here in figure. They belong to the same kingdom. Look at the figure and write the main reason for
grouping them under the same kingdom.
i) Multicellular and have various organ systems ii) Multicellular and heterotrophic
iii) Multicellular and parasitic
iv) Multicellular and oviparous
Ans:- ii) Multicellular and heterotrophic
7. Based on evolution, which of the following groups of organisms are closely related?
i) Porifera. Annelida Chordata
ii) Coelenterata, Arthropoda, Chordata
iii) Porifera, Arthropoda, Chordata
iv) Platyhelminthes, Nemathelminthes, Annelida
Ans:- iv) Platyhelminthes, Nemathelminthes, Annelida
8. Why are club mosses more advanced than the mosses?
i) Clubmoss grows on the land
ii) Clubmoss is sporophyte.
iii) Xylem and phloem tissue are found in clubmass
iv) Sporophyte is dominant in alternation of generation
Ans:- iii) Xylem and phloem tissue are found in clubmass
9. Which division do the plants having vascular tissue belong to?
i) Sporophyta
ii)Tracheophyta
iii) Gametophyta
iv) Spermatophyta
Ans:- ii)Tracheophyta
10. Which of the following is present in the animals belonging to the phylum chordata?
i) The body is covered with spiny skin and moves with tube feet

ii) The body is covered with water proof scale and respire through gills iii) The body is divisible into head, thorax and abdomen and can transfer malaria diseases. iv) The body have hollow tube, tentacles and stinging cells Ans:- ii) The body is covered with water proof scale and respire through gills
Section "B"
Very short answer type questions.
1. What is alternation of generations in the life cycle of Marchantia?
Ans:- The regular alternation between haploid gametophyte and diploid sporophyte phases in the life cycle of Marchantia is
called alternation of generations.
2. According to classification of living beings, which organisms evolved first on the Earth?
Ans:- Prokaryotes (bacteria).
3. What is meant by saprotrophic organism?
Ans:- Organisms that obtain food by decomposing dead and decaying organic matter are called saprotrophic organisms.
4. Write the name of any one unicellular algae.
Ans:- Chlamydomonas.
5. The plants belonging to bryophyta are called amphibian plants. Why?
Ans:- The plants belonging to bryophyta are called amphibian plants Because they live on land but need water for sexual
reproduction.

6. Write the name of any one organism having pneumatic bone. Ans:- Pigeon (or any bird). 7. How is cephalothorax formed? Ans:- By the fusion of the head and thorax in some arthropods (e.g., crab, prawn, spider). 8. What is the phylum of animal having high regeneration capacity? Ans:- Platyhelminthes. 9. What is meant by binomial system of nomenclature? Ans:- It is the system of naming organisms by using two names: the genus name and the species name (e.g., Homo sapiens). 10. Fem is not a flowering plant, Cycas bears cone but no fruit: banana bears flower and fruit. However, all these plants are kept in the same division. Why? Ans:- Fem is not a flowering plant, Cycas bears cone but no fruit: banana bears flower and fruit. However, all these plants are kept in the same division because all belong to Tracheophyta (vascular plants) having xylem and phloem tissues.
